topics.title: Introduction: Principles of renewable energy; energy and sustainable development, fundamentals and social
implications. worldwide renewable energy availability, renewable energy availabilit y in India, brief descriptions on
solar energy, wind energy, tidal energy, wave energy, ocean thermal en ergy, biomass energy, geothermal energy, oil
